toolDefinitions.name: fine-tune-list
toolDefinitions.description: List the fine-tuning jobs of the person you are talking to, newest first, including jobs started in the web page. A model can only control jobs it started.

toolDefinitions.name: fine-tune-start
toolDefinitions.description: Propose a new fine-tuning job. A person confirms it in the approval card; nothing starts before that. datasetSource is a Hugging Face ID or a reference from fine-tune-dataset. A model can only control jobs it started.

name.description: A label for the job, 1 to 80 characters.

model.description: Base model as a gallery or Hugging Face ID. A local path is refused.

backend.description: Fine-tuning backend. The default is trl.

trainingType.description: Kind of training. The default is lora.

trainingMethod.description: Training method. The default is sft.

datasetSource.description: Dataset as a Hugging Face ID or a reference from fine-tune-dataset. A local path is refused.

learningRate.description: Learning rate. Zero keeps the default.

numEpochs.description: Number of epochs. Zero keeps the default.

batchSize.description: Batch size. Zero keeps the default.

maxSteps.description: Stop after this many steps. Zero means no limit.

adapterRank.description: Rank of the adapter. Zero keeps the default.

adapterAlpha.description: Alpha of the adapter. Zero keeps the default.

toolDefinitions.name: fine-tune-dataset
toolDefinitions.description: Propose sending a small text dataset (up to 900 KiB, a .jsonl, .json, .csv or .txt file) to the server. A person confirms it. The reference it returns is the datasetSource of fine-tune-start, works for that person only and is lost when the server restarts. A model can only control jobs it started.

name.description: File name of the dataset, ending in .jsonl, .json, .csv or .txt. No folder.

content.description: The dataset as UTF-8 text, 1 byte to 900 KiB.

toolDefinitions.name: fine-tune-status
toolDefinitions.description: Show the status of a fine-tuning job that a tool started, or the reference of a dataset that fine-tune-dataset sent. A model can only control jobs it started.

resourceId.description: ID of the fine-tuning job, as returned by a job start. Only a job that a tool started has one.

toolDefinitions.name: fine-tune-checkpoints
toolDefinitions.description: List the saved checkpoints of a fine-tuning job that a tool started, with step and time. A model can only control jobs it started.

resourceId.description: ID of the fine-tuning job, as returned by a job start. Only a job that a tool started has one.

toolDefinitions.name: fine-tune-stop
toolDefinitions.description: Propose stopping a fine-tuning job that a tool started. A person confirms it. A model can only control jobs it started.

resourceId.description: ID of the fine-tuning job, as returned by a job start. Only a job that a tool started has one.

saveCheckpoint.description: Keep a checkpoint of the work so far. The default is false.

toolDefinitions.name: fine-tune-export
toolDefinitions.description: Propose registering the result of a fine-tuning job that a tool started as a model. Administrators only. A model can only control jobs it started.

resourceId.description: ID of the fine-tuning job, as returned by a job start. Only a job that a tool started has one.

exportFormat.description: Export format. The default is the engine default.

name.description: Name of the model, 1 to 64 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores. Leave out to let the engine choose.

ui.title: Fine-tuning
ui.description: Train an adapter on your own data, then export it as a model you can chat with.
